description_en: Retrieves a list of detection rules
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-detection-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --detection-rule-name Detect_Discovery_Behavior_for_Local_Systems_Groups --detection-rule-id dr-ppa85gfw69tgwkys0000 --detection-rule-ids dr-ppa85gfw69tgwkys0000 --detection-rule-type preset --detection-rule-status enabled --alert-type siem_rule_type_alert_storm --alert-level 1 --alert-tactic-id TA0042 --alert-att-ck Discovery --incident-aggregation-type graph_compute --log-category-id NETWORK_CATEGORY --log-schema-id API_RISK_ACTIVITY --detection-expression-type playbook --order-field-name GmtModified --order-direction asc --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --role-for 1130916744880000 --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of threat analysis is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
